# Utilization

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Utilization`](gmeow-Utilization.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Utilization>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A measurement of the ratio of current occupancy to maximum capacity at a location, typically expressed as a ratio (0–1) or percentage. The location is the [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md); the result is a [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md). Computed by the solver layer (P12) from capacity and occupancy measurements, not asserted directly in the canonical core.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Utilization`](gmeow-Utilization.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify the occupancy-to-capacity ratio at a location, as a [`Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly in the canonical core — it is computed by the solver from capacity and occupancy (P12).

### How to use

- Mint [`Utilization`](gmeow-Utilization.md), set [`gmeow:utilizationOf`](../properties/gmeow-utilizationOf.md), and point [`gmeow:observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) at a ratio/percentage [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md).

### Examples

- ex:util a [`gmeow:Utilization`](gmeow-Utilization.md); [`gmeow:utilizationOf`](../properties/gmeow-utilizationOf.md) ex:hall; [`gmeow:observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) ex:ratio024.
